# Pro Clean Surface Works

> Locally owned pressure washing company in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, cleaning driveways, house exteriors, sidewalks and curbs, patios, garbage cans and commercial property across East Baton Rouge, Ascension, Livingston and Iberville parishes.

Pro Clean Surface Works provides pressure washing and soft washing in Baton Rouge, LA for homeowners and businesses. It was founded by Grayson Allain, Riley Allain and Reid Scott, three friends who grew up together at Parkview Baptist in Baton Rouge. Hard surfaces like concrete are cleaned with high pressure and a flat-surface cleaner; siding, brick, stucco and painted surfaces are cleaned with a low-pressure soft wash so they are not damaged. Quotes are free and usually given the same day from a couple of photos.

Contact: (225) 363-5220 (call or text) / procleansurfaceworks@gmail.com

## Typical prices (ballpark, not quotes)

- Standard driveway: about $100 to $250
- Sidewalks and walkways: about $75 to $200
- Patios, porches and pool decks: about $100 to $350
- Single-story house soft wash: about $250 to $500 and up
